verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents sharing a search, thread or report with collaborators who can view or build on it. Threads turns searches into conversations, and organization plans offer centralized billing and account management, but neither is a sharing or collaboration capability. Sharing is a fair axis for a research tool, so this is none, not na.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can share a research session or report with collaborators who can view or build on it
